title: Sofía Vergara sold Beverly Hills villa for $13.7 million, had listed it for $19.6 million in 2022
summary_full: Sofía Vergara has officially sold her stunning Tuscan-style estate in Beverly Hills for $13.7 million in April 2024. Initially listed at $19.6 million in July 2022, after significant renovations, the price was reduced. Vergara, who acquired the property in 2014 for $10.6 million with Joe Manganiello, achieved a $3.1 million profit before expenses, boasting seven bedrooms, 11 bathrooms, and luxurious amenities throughout.
